description: An abstraction similar to CSS StyleSheets. Used to create, compose, flatten, and manage styles in React Native.

compose.description: Combines two style objects such that style2 overrides style1. If either style is falsy, the other is returned directly.
compose.signature: compose(style1: Object, style2: Object) => Object | Object[]

create.description: Creates a StyleSheet object and provides static type checking against native style properties.

styles.description: An object mapping keys to ViewStyle, TextStyle, or ImageStyle

flatten.description: Flattens an array of style objects into a single aggregated style object.

styles.description: Array of style objects to flatten

setStyleAttributePreprocessor.description: Experimental. Sets a function to pre-process a style property value, e.g., colors or transforms.

process.description: Function that processes the property value

notes: Experimental API: may change or be removed without notice.

absoluteFill.description: Predefined style for overlays with position absolute and zero positioning (left:0, right:0, top:0, bottom:0).

absoluteFillObject.description: Like absoluteFill but can be customized for minor tweaks.

hairlineWidth.description: Width of a thin line on the platform. Useful for borders or separators. Value may vary between devices.

usage_tips: Move styles outside of render functions for better performance and readability.
Use StyleSheet.create() for static type checking and IDE suggestions.
Name styles meaningfully to encourage reuse and clarity.
